answer: Sybil defense is a one-root bonded identity. A new agent locks 500 units for 14 days, so every extra persona must fill that capital canyon. A hardware-attestation bridge then maps one root key to one live bond; a second identity sharing the root is slashed and both bonds burn. Each accepted bond is issued as a unique marble serial on-ledger, transferable only after unlock and revoked if a linked-key cluster is proven. A 10,000-sybil farm would lock 5 million and risk total slash.
